name: Spice Village (CGH Earth)
summary: Spice Village is a CGH Earth eco-resort at Thekkady, close to the Periyar Tiger Reserve. Its 52 cottages are thatched with elephant grass in the style of the local Mannan tribe, and it has its own Ayurveda centre.
highlights: 52 cottages thatched with elephant grass, after Mannan tribal dwellings
Listed by Kerala Tourism as an Ayurveda centre; Ayurveda centre and spa on site
About three-quarters of its power from solar energy
Organic farm, yoga and naturalist-led walks
Close to Periyar Tiger Reserve: ranger treks and bamboo rafting nearby
